decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the erection of side and rear dormer roof extension to the existing house, as shown on drawings numbered 801/1, 801/2, 801/3A, 801/4B and 801/5, received 1st November 2006, is recommended for approval as the size, position and style of the dormers and roof lights would not be detrimental to the appearance of the existing building, the amenity of neighbouring properties or would detract from the character of the Conservation Area. The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Erection of side and rear dormer roof extensions to the existing house
